patch_description: Replace the 24-parameter layer with a symmetry-regularized, real-valued layer using one shared RY angle for even wires and one for odd wires. This retains local rotations on every qubit and the proven CZ connectivity while reducing each repeated block to only two trainable parameters. Removing the independent RZ rotations avoids redundant phase freedom, should preserve the already perfect accuracy on this apparently simple task, and strongly improves parameter economy, convergence, and resistance to overfitting.
